request: mix: ファイルのハッシュを色付きの視覚指紋として表示する / 引数のファイル（なければ標準入力）の SHA-256 を計算し、ssh-keygen の randomart と同じ「ドランクンビショップ」方式で 17x9 の枠付きアスキーアートを描き、訪問回数ごとに ANSI 256色で色付けして標準出力に出す。下に16進ハッシュも1行出し、2つのファイルが同一かを目で素早く比べられる。例：hashart a.iso と hashart b.iso を並べて実行すると、同一なら模様も色も完全に一致し、1バイト違えば全く別の模様になる。フラグは -n（色なし）のみ。コマンド名は hashart

spec.name: hashart
spec.summary: hashart prints a colored 17x9 drunken-bishop randomart and the hex SHA-256 of a file or stdin.

flags.name: n
flags.help: no color: print plain ASCII without escape codes

behavior: B1: With no file argument, read all of stdin; with one file argument, read that file. Compute the SHA-256 (32 bytes) of the data. Empty input is valid.

B2: The grid is 17 columns (x 0..16) by 9 rows (y 0..8), all visit counts 0. The bishop starts at x=8, y=4. For each digest byte in order, for i = 0..3, take b = (byte >> (2*i)) & 3 (least significant bits first): x += 1 if b&1 is set else x -= 1; y += 1 if b&2 is set else y -= 1; then clamp x to 0..16 and y to 0..8; then add 1 to the visit count of cell (x,y). The start cell is not counted initially.

B3: Cell character: the ramp is the 15 characters " .o+=*BOX@%&#/^" (first is a space) indexed by min(count,14). Then the start cell (8,4) is drawn as S and the final cell where the bishop ends is drawn as E; E wins if they are the same cell.

B4: Stdout is: a top line "+" + 17 "-" + "+"; then 9 rows, each "|" + 17 cell characters + "|"; then a bottom line identical to the top; then one line with the 64-character lowercase hex digest. Every line ends with a newline. Frame and hex lines are never colored.

B5: Without -n, every cell whose character is not a space is written as ESC "[38;5;" N "m" char ESC "[0m" (ESC is byte 0x1b); space cells are written as a plain space. For ramp characters N = palette[min(count,14)-1] with palette = 27,33,39,45,51,48,46,82,118,154,190,226,208,196. S uses N=46 and E uses N=196. With -n no escape codes are written at all.
B6: If the file cannot be read, print "hashart: " followed by the error text to stderr, print nothing to stdout, and exit 1.

B7: If more than one non-flag argument is given, print "hashart: too many arguments" and the line "usage: hashart [-n] [file]" to stderr and exit 2. An unknown flag is a usage error with exit 2 (the flag package's message on stderr). On success exit 0.
